issues.description: The solution repository introduces an extra pushed argument (push 123) and a comment noting an 'Incorrect order', which conflicts with the template usage and the problem instruction about how printf arguments should be passed. The template pushes only the format string (push hello) before calling printf, and the problem statement instructs passing the format string then arguments. The solution's example therefore demonstrates an inconsistent and confusing argument-passing order for printf compared to the template and problem description.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution consistent with the template and problem statement: remove the extraneous 'push 123' from the solution so it only pushes the format string (push hello) before calling printf, or if demonstrating argument passing, correct the example and the problem text to explicitly explain the push order (arguments must be pushed right-to-left so push argument(s) first, then push format string) and adjust the solution code/comments accordingly.
